name: Cholec80
description: A dataset of 80 laparoscopic cholecystectomy videos from 13 surgeons, annotated with surgical phases and tool presence.
citation: Twinanda, A. P., Shehata, S., Mutter, D., Marescaux, J., de Mathelin, M., and Padoy, N. (2017). EndoNet: A Deep Architecture for Recognition Tasks on Laparoscopic Videos. IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging, 36(1), 86–97. https://doi.org/10.1109/TMI.2016.2593957
